description.p: Blobr is the jamsdesign suite's interface and vector design app. Lay out screens with frames, shapes, text and auto layout on an infinite canvas, build components and variants, and turn them into clickable prototypes.

ul.li: Auto layout, constraints, live boolean groups and a pen tool
Components with variants, properties, libraries and design tokens
Prototypes with smart animate, scrolling and flows
Comments, developer handoff (CSS, HTML, iced) and PNG, SVG and PDF export
AI agents can read and edit designs through Blobr's MCP server, live in the app
Plugins in any language, using the same tools as agents

description.p: Designs are .jdb files on your own disk.
